<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex20022023-09-15-130857" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
               <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (57b4-7)"/>
        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4621"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma</rs>'i rnam bshad don dam rnam nges bsdus pa'i snying po'i snying po</rs> zhes bya ba  
        <lg> <l><lb n="57b5"/> (l)o<anchor xml:id="a2"/> <note type="editorial">This syllable is not very clear in the manuscript, only the vowel 'o' is clear. The typed text (ID: 8135) has 'lo'</note> ni <choice><reg>mche</reg><orig>mcha</orig></choice><anchor xml:id="a3"/> ldan zla ba rgya mtsho dang ||</l> <l>tshes ni dkar phyogs rdzogs pa dang po la || </l>  <!--5th day of the waxing moon--> 
        <l>gnas ni <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5740">rnam dag zhing</rs> gi ming can du || </l>         
        <l>ming ni dge slong smra ba'i khyu mchog<anchor xml:id="a4"/> ste ||</l></lg><note type="editorial">From 'gnas ni', this section is supplied by the printed version of this text (ID: 8135). In the manuscript it is illegible.</note>
         de yang 'di ltar ¦ 
        <lg> <l>legs par sbyangs pa'i blo gros can || </l>
         <l>lung rigs snyan dngags kyi dbang phyug || </l> 
         <l><lb n="57b6"/> mdo rgyud smra la yang dga' ba || </l>
        <l> 'dzaM gling mdzes par byed pa'i brgyan || </l>
        <l><rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5559">gangs can</rs> gyi ston sgom u dum wa ra'i me tog zhes kyang bya ste ¦ </l> </lg>
         
         nges par ni × 
         <lg>
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3910">dge</rs> legs ster byed bshes legs bsten | </l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3910">'dun</rs> tshul phul byung thub tshul sgrub | </l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3910">'od </rs>stong yangs 'phro <lb n="57b7"/> mchog stong mchod | </l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3910">zer</rs> ngas [=nges] bden byed<anchor xml:id="a5"/> nges nges sdebs ||</l> </lg> zhes bya'o | </seg></TEI>
source: 1_020_02 dGe 'dun 'od zer_theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i rnam bshad don dam rnam nges bsdus pa'i snying po.xml
